scope: HBQ per-vehicle feature intent applied to existing CBE driving-aid scopes
sourceIntent: An operator can disable a driving feature on one vehicle independently of other vehicles, layered over global defaults.
implementation: Optional actual vehicle argument to shared feature helper reads CBE_Driving_DisabledFeatures; list/ALL can only exclude, never enable CBA/group-disabled features. Invalid container refuses the aid without mutation.

Actual vehicle is bound at ordinary assistance selection, startup candidates, native cap publication, recovery issue/retry, crew handling, bypass/corridor, passing preparation/consent, queue-owner recovery validation, server gate commit and deferred native path checks.

Convoy lead and each follower independently resolve optional driving/path aid. An excluded lead does not disable other followers; excluded followers discard retained optional path caps and clean path observers while convoy spacing/task remains.

Ordinary master exclusion uses existing exact-owner release. Recovery/automatic passing exclusions retain current issued-leg safety and pending-native handback policy; no forced stop or stale replay is introduced.
CBA remains global configuration. Published mission object exclusions are script controls, not a new Zeus settings module or force-enable UI.
departures: HBQ per-vehicle force-enable over global disable is deliberately not copied.
Keys implement the five existing CBE ordinary/recovery/automatic-passing/convoy-assist/convoy-route-recovery scopes, not every distinct HBQ feature variable.
No Eden per-vehicle settings surface is added. Automatic passing exclusion does not revoke explicit manual task authority beyond the existing CBA semantics.

validation.source: 585c1514+dirty unsigned development; not a later clean commit package
validation.retainedFocusedFindings: Prior guard text changed; test now checks both vehicle exclusion and native destination-control authority. Passing retains its false CBA default; binding check accepts true/false rather than changing defaults.

remaining: No full-HBQ feature-variable parity or native queue execution claim.
Live per-vehicle exclusions, issued reverse/pass handback, independent mixed-column behavior and normal/HC/JIP delivery remain unverified.
No measured performance result for extra read-only per-vehicle gate reads.
